history.summary: Modern (2021) efficient 570 sqft 2BR in West Coast at a low $1.0M quantum and $1,754 PSF — ~8% below the $1,902 URA median — with a sound 4.14% appreciation over 147 txns and a future Jurong Region Line station nearby. Good value and liquidity, with the soft point being the ~1.1km MRT distance and OCR-typical growth.

history.summary: Newer (TOP 2021) 520-unit leasehold at West Coast Vale, D05, by CSC Land. Asking $1,754 psf is meaningfully below the project's recent average, and a dated MRT catalyst (West Coast CRL/JRL by 2032) supports the forward case.
history.rating_rationale: Verified value plus a real catalyst. Twin VEW's last-12-month transactions run $1,699-$2,008 psf (avg ~$1,877); this listing at $1,754 psf is ~7% below average and near the floor of the recent band — a genuine discount, consistent with the algo's age_adj_premium -12.1% (here corroborated, not a quirk). The forward catalyst is concrete and dated: the new West Coast MRT (Cross Island Line Phase 2 + Jurong Region Line interchange) is slated to open by 2032 within the West Coast Vale corridor, plus proximity to Clementi, NUS and one-north. District 5 sits in the favorable OCR/RCR forward-return band per the v3.4 backtest. Main caveat is the 'bedroom_sqft_mismatch' flag: 570sqft is shoebox/1BR-sized, so the '2BR' label is likely a compact dual-key or 2BR-compact (or a mislabel) — this affects rentability/exit nuance and the cohort is thin (psf_cohort_txns=4), so confidence is medium not high. On verified cheapness + dated MRT catalyst + favorable region, a measured Buy.
red_flags: bedroom_sqft_mismatch — 570sqft is shoebox-sized for a '2BR'; likely compact/dual-key or a label error to confirm on viewing
psf_cohort_txns=4 — same-size comparison set is thin
99-yr leasehold; large 520-unit project means concurrent-supply competition at resale/rental
Trailing 4.14% CAGR is the highest here but, per v3.4, carries ~0 forward weight on its own
